title: Written Cells Were Visited
statement: Let $M$ be a nondeterministic Turing machine with $k$ work tapes and Boolean tape symbols, let $x$ be a Boolean input word, let $w$ be a finite choice word, let $i$ be a work-tape index, and let $z\in\mathbb{Z}$. If cell $z$ on tape $i$ contains a symbol after running $M$ from its initial configuration on $x$ under $w$, then $z$ is among the head positions visited on tape $i$ during that run, including the initial position and the positions after each of the first $|w|$ steps.
hypotheses_covered: A nondeterministic machine with $k$ work tapes and Boolean symbols
The cell at $z$ on tape $i$ is nonblank after the run
